name: teraswitch Seoul Data Center
notes: Directory listing places teraswitch Seoul Data Center at Seoul Sky, Olympic-ro, Songpa-gu. Capacity and operator details were not independently verified from a primary source.

name: KT Mokdong IDC 1
notes: Data Center Map and KT Estate brochure excerpts identify KT Mokdong IDC at 924-4 Mok-dong, Yangcheon-gu, with 64,189 sq m gross floor area; DCM specs list year operational 2008 and Tier 3 design, but no MW supplied.

name: KT Mokdong IDC 2 / KT Mok-dong DC 2
notes: DCD reported KT Cloud's AI Data Center Demonstration Center would launch at KT's Mok-dong DC 2 Center in Yangcheon District in November 2025; KT Estate brochure excerpt lists KT Mokdong IDC 2 at 918-1 Mok-dong, Yangcheon-gu, with 50,318 sq m gross floor area.

name: KDT IDC Mokdong Data Center
notes: KDT IDC's official centers page lists DC2 Mokdong Data Center inside KT ICC, Mok-dong, Yangcheon-gu, Seoul, with carrier-neutral colocation, 400G backbone, DDoS protection, resident engineers, and 24/7 monitoring.

name: Actis / Epoch Digital Yangpyeong Data Centre
notes: Seoul Property Insight reported Actis began operating the DITO Yangpyeong Center in Yangpyeong-dong, Yeongdeungpo-gu, with 26 MW capacity. Cushman & Wakefield's 1H 2024 marketbeat listed Actis Yangpyeong Data Centre in Yeongdeungpo at 26 MW while under construction.

name: KT Yeouido IDC / KT Yeouido DC
notes: Colocation directories and Zenlayer list KT Yeouido IDC/DC at 14 Yeoui-daero, Yeongdeungpo-gu. OCOLO describes it as a dedicated facility for a securities company and the only commercial data center in Yeouido; capacity not found.

name: Okestro Yeouido Data Center
notes: Data Center Map lists Okestro Yeouido at 108 Yeoui-daero. Baxtel search excerpt describes Okestro and DC Korea's Yeouido sovereign AI data center as 5 MW; capacity is directory-derived and should be treated as weak evidence.

name: KT DX IDC Yongsan / KT Yongsan DC
notes: DCD reported KT opened KT DX IDC Yongsan in Seoul, a seven-story building with six underground floors and 48,000 sq m total space. Directory listings place KT Yongsan DC at 33 Wonhyo-ro 41-gil / Wonhyo-ro 41-gil, Yongsan District; MW not found.

name: SK Group / AWS Ulsan AI Data Center
developer: SK Group / SK Telecom / SK Broadband / Amazon Web Services
notes: Asia Business Daily reported SK Group and AWS are constructing a 103 MW AI-dedicated data center on a 36,000 sq m site in Hwangseong-dong, Nam-gu, Ulsan, within Ulsan Mipo National Industrial Complex. Schedule reported: launch ceremony June 2025, groundbreaking August 2025, 40 MW first phase operational by November 2027, full 103 MW by February 2029.

name: KIOST Ulsan Underwater Data Center Complex / Sinri Port Testbed
developer: Korea Institute of Ocean Science and Technology; Ulsan Metropolitan City; GS Engineering & Construction; POSCO
notes: DCD reported KIOST, Ulsan, GS E&C, and POSCO signed an agreement for eco-friendly underwater data center complex construction technology research targeting a seabed complex with 100,000 servers. The first underwater module/testbed is planned 30 m underwater off Sinri Port, Seosaeng-myeon, Ulju-gun.
